title: Lead, Patient Access Programs
description:
Who We Are:

SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company.  Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service.  With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

• Integrity: Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.

• Courage: We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward-always.

• Together: The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

Job Summary:

As a Lead (Supervisor) for our Patient Access Team, you will be responsible for the operational efficiency of our team responsible for procuring medications through drug manufacturers and for enrollment of patient members in drug savings programs. Your team serves as our patient members' advocate, guiding them through the complex world of prescriptions to help them obtain medications in a cost-effective and timely manner.

In this role, you will provide leadership, coaching, and oversight to a high-performing team of Inbound Patient Access Specialists and Enterprise Patient Access Specialists delivering one-call resolution and high-touch concierge support across phone, email, and digital channels. You will manage real-time call center workflows, ensure efficient allocation of operational center resources, resolve critical case escalations, and drive team performance to help meet organizational KPIs and ensure member satisfaction.

This role reports directly to the Manager of Patient Access Programs.

What you will do:

• Directly manage, coach, and mentor a team of Inbound and Enterprise Patient Access Specialists whose primary responsibility is to help members apply and enroll into patient assistance and drug savings programs.

• Recruit, hire, and onboard new team members, leading initial training and continuous professional development.

• Provide day-to-day supervision and support, managing phone queue availability, workforce schedule adherence, and real-time operational center resource allocation.

• Serve as an escalation path for complex, high-urgency, or critical calls-particularly those originating from dedicated Enterprise client groups-taking ownership of end-to-end resolutions.

• Manage team to target KPIs associated with our patient advocate teams, including First Call Resolution (FCR), queue SLAs, handle times, Quality Assurance (QA) scores, and member satisfaction metrics.

• Perform regular 1:1s, call monitoring, and quality audits to foster active listening, empathetic communication, PBM system proficiency, and strict compliance with PHI and HIPAA regulations.

• Identify and drive operational process improvements to eliminate bottlenecks, support scale, and elevate the member journey across all savings pathways.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Management, Clinical Strategy, Customer Support, and Operations to stay aligned on Enterprise account nuances, policy updates, and plan design rollouts.

title: Clinical Product Specialist
description:
We’re hiring a Clinical Product Specialist to advance the usefulness and trustworthiness of Blueprint’s AI tools for mental health professionals.
Building AI for clinicians requires more than adding clinical review at the end of the product-development process. Clinical judgment must shape how problems are defined, how systems are designed, and how quality is measured. We're looking for someone who has actually done the work-sat with a client in acute risk and decided what to do next, chosen an intervention and adjusted it when it wasn't landing, managed a full week of sessions and everything that surrounds them-and who can bring that judgment directly into how our products get built. You’ll develop evaluation methods, improve AI behavior, identify failure modes, and help teams make thoughtful clinical, product, and business trade-offs.
This is not a traditional clinical-advisory position. You’ll work hands-on with AI systems while serving as a clinical expert among clinicians, product managers, designers, and engineers. You’ll turn nuanced clinical needs into clear product requirements and measurable quality standards, then help carry solutions from an ambiguous problem through a successful release.
What you’ll own

• Define what clinically excellent AI output looks like for the product surfaces you support, translating clinical judgment into clear standards and measurable criteria. That typically includes designing and maintaining clinical evaluation suites, including representative test cases, scoring rubrics, benchmarks, and processes for identifying regressions

• Ground those standards in evidence-based practice and real-world care delivery, for example how a clinician actually reasons through a case, selects and sequences interventions, responds and documents risk, and what a clinician needs in order to trust and act on what the product tells them

• Work hands-on with prompts, models, and product workflows to improve quality, analyze failure modes, and determine when solutions are ready for customers

• Set the clinical bar for how our products handle high-acuity content and define what appropriate handling looks like in an AI-assisted workflow

• Contribute to ambiguous clinical-product initiatives from problem definition through a shippable plan, working alongside product, engineering, design, and other stakeholders on the right trade-offs to make

• Partner directly with customers and clinical leaders to understand their workflows and concerns, translate their needs into product requirements, and build confidence in Blueprint’s approach

• Contribute to clinical-quality methodology and reusable practices that raise the standard of AI product development across Blueprint

Who we’re looking for

• You’re a licensed behavioral health clinician with direct-care experience and strong clinical judgment.

• You’re fluent in evidence-based approaches such as CBT, ACT, DBT, and MI, and know how to select, adapt, and evaluate interventions.

• You’ve practiced measurement-based care, using outcomes and progress data to guide treatment.

• You have experience assessing clinical risk-including suicidality and higher-acuity presentations-and understand responsible documentation and escalation.

• You understand how clinicians work in practice, from planning sessions and evolving treatment plans to managing caseloads and time pressure.

• You’ve contributed to AI-enabled, digital health, or similarly technical clinical initiatives; experience with behavioral health documentation or workflows is especially valuable.

• You’re comfortable evaluating and improving generative AI systems through prompt iteration, structured evaluation, output review, and failure-mode analysis.

• You can translate clinical nuance into clear product requirements and measurable quality standards, partnering effectively with product managers and engineers.

title: Network Support Engineer
description:
About Product
VyOS is an open-source network operating system that provides an all-in-one platform for network management. Built on Linux, VyOS integrates powerful routing, firewall, VPN, and network services into a unified system. Unlike traditional networking hardware, VyOS can be deployed on a wide range of platforms, from physical routers and cloud environments to virtual machines, giving users flexibility and control over their network infrastructure.
The key strength of VyOS lies in its comprehensive feature set. It supports dynamic routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, RIP), multiple VPN types (IPsec, OpenVPN, WireGuard), firewall rules, traffic shaping, and more - all configured through a unified command-line interface (CLI) familiar to network engineers. Its ability to scale across various environments makes it popular with organizations seeking open-source networking solutions.
Job description
The Network Support Engineer is responsible for developing, validating, and optimizing VyOS networking solutions to ensure performance, stability, and usability. This role involves designing Proof of Concept (PoC) scenarios, testing new features, troubleshooting complex issues, and maintaining technical documentation. The Network Engineer will work closely with developers, support teams, and external partners to enhance VyOS compatibility and functionality across diverse network environments.

• Design and deploy PoC scenarios using VyOS, documenting configuration setups, performance benchmarks, and solution viability for customer-specific requirements.

• Diagnose and resolve network performance, security, and connectivity issues, utilizing advanced debugging and analysis tools.

• Investigate escalated technical issues, conduct root cause analysis, and deliver reproducible solutions or detailed technical reports for development resolution.

• Conduct functional, performance, and regression testing for VyOS features and fixes, creating and maintaining detailed test documentation.

• Develop and manage automated test frameworks for repetitive test cases, enhancing testing accuracy and efficiency.

• Enhance testing methodologies by introducing advanced tools and frameworks to optimize validation processes and outcomes.

• Conduct interoperability testing with third-party systems to ensure seamless integration of VyOS into diverse networking environments.

• Maintain a centralized knowledge base with detailed, technically accurate articles and solution documentation to support internal and external stakeholders.

Requirements
Skills

• Strong understanding of networking protocols such as BGP, OSPF, VPNs, and firewalls.

• Hands-on experience with VyOS or other open-source networking platforms.

• Proficiency in scripting languages like Python or Bash for automation and testing.

description:

Ми виконуємо роль віддаленого бек-офісу для майстрів у США, що спеціалізуються на ремонтних роботах. У зв’язку з активним розвитком локальних маркетингових каналів ми шукаємо сильного Team Lead Marketing , який зможе не лише керувати командою, а й стратегічно розвивати напрямок, масштабувати результати та впливати на бізнес-показники.
Що ти отримаєш, ставши частиною Supplax:

• Стабільний дохід в $: ставка (обговорюється) + бонуси за виконання KPI.

• Повну зайнятість, графік роботи: Пн-Пт з 9:00 до 18:00.

• Можливість впливати на стратегію та розвиток напряму.

• Зручний формат: 100% віддалена робота з будь-якої точки світу.

• Можливість працювати в стабільній компанії на ринку США, яка росте та розвивається разом зі своїми людьми.

• Професійний розвиток у digital-, PPC- та performance-маркетингу.

• Команду, де цінують ініціативу та експертність.

Що ти робитимеш щодня:
Керуватимеш операційною та стратегічною роботою команди, яка відповідає за розвиток локальних платформ США (насамперед Yelp). 70% робочого часу - управління командою: постановка цілей, розвиток співробітників, контроль процесів і результатів. 30% часу - hands-on робота: самостійне ведення окремих задач, запуск і оптимізація кампаній, тестування нових підходів та допомога команді там, де це необхідно.
Твоя роль включає:

• Побудову та розвиток напрямку Yelp як повноцінного performance-каналу.

• Формування та реалізацію маркетингової стратегії просування.

• Управління командою маркетологів (6 осіб): постановка задач, контроль результатів, розвиток експертизи.

• Оптимізація ключових бізнес-метрик: CPL, CPA, ROI, обсяг та якість лідів.

• Масштабування рекламних кампаній та пошук нових точок росту.

• Роботу з аналітикою та прийняття рішень на основі даних.

• Тісну взаємодію з командами продажів, аналітики, продукту та операцій.

• Запуск нових міст, ніш та тестування маркетингових гіпотез.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Python
description:
Senior AI Interaction Evaluator (Codex / Claude Code)
Contract | $100-$200/hour | 10-20 hrs/week | Start ASAP (through early May)
Check out this Loom video for more details!
We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
This is not a traditional engineering role.
You won’t be writing production code.
You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.
What This Role Actually Is
You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios - focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

• Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

• Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

• Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste - not syntax correctness.
What You’ll Be Doing

• Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

•
Judge whether outputs are:

• Useful

• Correct (at a high level)

• Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

• Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning , not just code

• Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4 )

•
Provide clear, opinionated feedback on:

• What worked

• What didn’t

• What felt “off” or misleading

• Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor

What We Mean by “Taste”
We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

• Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

• Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

• Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

• Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments .
Who You Are

• Staff / Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

•
Strong background in one of the below:

• TypeScript / JavaScript

• Python

•
Hands-on experience using:

• OpenAI Codex

• Claude Code

• Cursor

• Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

• Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line

• Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

• High bar for what “good engineering” looks like

Nice to Have

• Experience with tools like Cursor or similar AI-first IDEs

• Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement Details

• Rate: $100-$200/hour

• Hours: ~10-20 hours/week

• Duration: Through early May (with possible extension)

• Start: ASAP

Process:

• Take-home evaluation exercise

• One behavioral interview

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

A vendor portal login is stored in an employee’s personal vault. The employee leaves the company, but the team still relies on the account. No one has rotated the password, and no administrator knows the credential exists. This gap between the credentials a company uses and the credentials it can see is what Credential Governance is built to close.

Credential Governance gives enterprise administrators a central view of company-owned credentials across employee and shared vaults. It enables them to take ownership of those credentials, control how they’re accessed, and manage that access over time. The product brings visibility and accountability to credentials that have historically been difficult to track.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to guide this high-visibility product through launch and into maturity. You’ll lead a team building the governance capabilities that help enterprises secure critical credentials and get more value from 1Password. You’ll also help define how 1Password manages company-owned credentials as organizations and their teams grow.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction https://www.monumental.co/our-vision/, and learn about our vision and company https://www.monumental.co/about/. You might enjoy Based in Europe's film https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2-Q2F0Fcx4A on how we're fixing Europe's housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOo8n19XEns of what our office looks like.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Hiring well is the single biggest thing that decides how fast Monumental can go, and the top of our funnel is where we most need horsepower.

This is a role for someone near the start of their career who wants to learn to hire well, fast. You'll work alongside Dom and the recruiting team as a junior recruiter - the person who finds candidates, reads their CVs, and runs the first call that decides who moves forward. It's high-volume, high-judgment work: you'll interact with most of the people who enter our process, and the quality of what you pass up decides the status of our pipelines.

To be clear about what this looks like day to day: you'll start with our highest-volume hiring, robot operators and technicians for our workshop and construction sites, and this is where most of your time will go, especially in your first months. Some of the work is unglamorous, and we won't pretend otherwise: expect lots of first-stage interviewing, chasing down leads, and doing what's needed to grow a high-performing team. It's also some of the highest-leverage work in the company. When our hiring engine runs smoothly, we have more hands free to build robots and brick walls on construction sites for our customers. As you build the instinct for it, you'll take on more of our hiring across the company over time.

You'll get real ownership of the top of the funnel from the start, close support from people who are excellent at this, and a clear path to owning full searches as you grow. Get good at this and you'll become a recruiter who can be handed any role, however unusual, and fill it well.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll own the top of our hiring funnel, plus whatever else the team needs a hand with.

- Sourcing. Find candidates for the roles you're driving, mostly our field and operator hiring, across job boards, LinkedIn, referrals and inbound ad responses, and build strong shortlists worth the hiring manager's time.

- CV and application screens. Read candidates against what "great" actually looks like for each role, not just a keyword match. You'll calibrate your judgment fast by doing this at volume.

- First calls. Qualify candidates, get them excited about Monumental, and make an accurate first read on whether they clear the bar. This is the part that matters most, and the part you'll get better at fastest.

- Keep the pipeline moving. Schedule interviews, keep Ashby clean and up to date, and make sure no candidate goes cold or waits on us. A fast, tight process is a competitive advantage and you own it.

About Amperity -Why This, Why Now
Most customer data is a lie by omission.
Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap-between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true-is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.
With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being-in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands-like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running-trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.
Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company-not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being the ones who can make it trustworthy.
So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like-alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus-this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.
We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. If that’s how you want to be measured, we would love to speak with you.

title: Project Manager - Client Onboarding
description:
Project Manager, Client Onboarding
CrelioHealth Inc. · Remote (United States) · Full-time · Travel to client sites (~25-40%)
Compensation: $95,000 - $120,000 base, depending on experience + performance incentives (including incentives on expansion or referral opportunities you help close). Benefits include health coverage and PTO.
About CrelioHealth

CrelioHealth builds cloud-based laboratory information systems (LIS/LIMS) that power diagnostic labs across the United States and 2,500+ labs worldwide. Our platform runs the full lab workflow - from order booking and specimen tracking through result reporting, patient engagement, billing, and inventory - for physician office labs, hospital labs, reference labs, and direct-to-consumer testing companies. We are HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified, and growing quickly in the US market.
The Role
When a lab signs with CrelioHealth , you are the person who turns that signature into a running lab. You will own client onboarding end to end: planning the implementation, configuring the rollout with our product and support teams, training lab staff, managing the go-live, and making sure the client is delighted enough to expand and refer. You are the face of CrelioHealth from kickoff to steady state.
This is not a sales role. You carry no quota and you will never cold-call. But onboarding is where trust is built, and trust is where growth comes from. We want someone who can confidently present the platform, handle a skeptical lab director, and spot the moment a client is ready for another module or another location - and who earns incentives when those opportunities convert.
What You Will DoOwn implementations

• Lead onboarding projects for new US clients - single-site labs through multi-location networks - from kickoff through go-live and handover to support.

• Build and run the implementation plan: scope, milestones, data migration, instrument interfaces, integrations (EHR/EMR, billing, HL7/FHIR), user setup, and validation.

• Coordinate internal teams (product, engineering, support) and client stakeholders (lab directors, pathologists, techs, front-desk, billing, IT) to keep every go-live on schedule.

• Travel to client sites for kickoffs, go-lives, and training - roughly 25-40% of your time, varying with the project calendar.

Make clients successful

• Train lab staff on real workflows - accessioning, worklists, QC, reporting, patient portal - and adapt the training to how each lab actually operates.

• Anticipate and manage change resistance: a lab switching its LIS is changing how everyone works, and you will guide them through it.

• Track onboarding health (time-to-go-live, adoption, early ticket volume) and report status honestly to clients and leadership.

Champion the platform

• Present and demo CrelioHealth confidently - to the client team that signed, and to the wider staff who did not choose it but must love it.

• Identify expansion opportunities during onboarding (additional modules, locations, or referrals) and hand them to the growth team - with incentives for you when they close.

• Feed what you learn on the ground back into product and our onboarding playbook, which you will help write.

What We Are Looking For (Must-haves)

•
4-7 years of project management experience , with at least 2 years implementing or onboarding software for external clients.

•
Healthcare experience is required ; hands-on time in a clinical laboratory or laboratory environment is strongly preferred - as a lab tech, lab manager, LIS analyst, or implementer of lab systems (LIS/LIMS, EHR, RCM).

• Fluency with lab operations concepts: specimen lifecycle, accessioning, QC/QA, instrument interfacing, CLIA/CAP context, HIPAA, and result reporting.

• Excellent presenter and communicator - comfortable running a room of skeptical clinicians, and equally comfortable on a video call with a solo lab owner.

description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Termin:
INGENIEUR*IN FÜR VERSORGUNGSTECHNIK / HLKS (M/W/X)
IN VOLLZEIT
Am Standort: Burghaun
rauschenberg ingenieure gmbh ist seit 1994 ein visionäres Ingenieurbüro mit drei Standorten in Burghaun bei Fulda, Hagen-Hohenlimburg und Mechernich-Kommern. Mit rund 70 motivierten Mitarbeiter*innen verwirklichen wir für staatliche und private Auftraggeber Bauprojekte in der technischen Gebäudeausrüstung, übernehmen die Generalplanung oder setzen als Architekturbüro neue Maßstäbe.
Hast Du Lust, Deine Visionen in unsere Projekte mit einfließen zu lassen? Möchtest Du Teil unseres engagierten und motivierten Teams werden? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!
Aufgaben

Als Projekt-Ingenieur*in bist Du für die zeitliche und fachgerechte Realisierung der Dir zugeteilten Baumaßnahme verantwortlich. Du begleitest das Projekt vom Konzept bis zur Übergabe, hast die Terminsetzungen und das Budget im Blick.
Du entwickelst nicht nur innovative Anlagenkonzepte, sondern erstellst auch TGA-Fachplanungen inkl. aller Leistungsverzeichnisse.
Du erstellst und prüfst alle notwendigen Unterlagen und stehst mit dem*r Auftraggeber*in, mit der Fachplanung und mit sonstigen Projektbeteiligten im engen Austausch.
Du wirkst aktiv an der kontinuierlichen Qualitätsverbesserung bzw. Qualitätssicherung mit.
Du schaust regelmäßig auf der Baustelle vorbei und überwachst die Umsetzung der Baumaßnahmen.

Qualifikation

Du bringst ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Versorgungstechnik, technische Gebäudeausrüstung, HLKS (Heizung, Lüftung, Klima, Sanitär) oder Ähnliches mit. Techniker*innen und Meister*innen sind ebenso willkommen.
Du hast ein fundiertes und technisches Wissen sowie ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an der Versorgungstechnik.</
